items.title: World Mental Health Day
items.description: A useful date for a coffee morning, Tea & Talk, wellbeing walk or community conversation. The 2026 theme is ‘Lived experiences heard: Real voices, real change’.

items.title: World Suicide Prevention Day
items.description: Annual suicide-prevention awareness day. Useful for planning a supportive conversation, information event or signposting campaign well in advance.

items.title: Abingdon MIND mental-health drop-in
items.description: Local MIND mental-health drop-in listed by Oxfordshire County Council. Useful as a local activity to share or as inspiration for a similar event.

items.title: Oxford Half Marathon for Oxfordshire Mind
items.description: Oxfordshire Mind community fundraising event around movement, connection and mental health.

items.title: Parent Carer Wellbeing Hub
items.description: Relaxed wellbeing session for parent carers to connect, share experiences and find local support.

items.title: Developmental Trauma and ACEs training
items.description: Free Targeted Mental Health in Schools training on developmental trauma, adversity and supporting children and young people.

items.title: Mind Over Mountains wellbeing walk
items.description: Therapeutic outdoor wellbeing walk listed in Buckinghamshire Council’s family information service.

items.title: Mental Health & Suicide First Aid training
items.description: Buckinghamshire Mind and Buckinghamshire Council offer funded Mental Health First Aid and Suicide First Aid courses during 2026 and 2027. Check the organiser for current dates.
